'''Matas Havel''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Merchant/Legends|trader]] and the first owner of the [[YT-2400 light freighter/Legends|YT-2400]] transport later called the ''[[Lambarian Crab]]''. At some point, Havel modified the ship, adding extra cargo space and enhanced shielding to deal with [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]]. He would later sell the ship to [[Finious Crab]] three years after he bought it.<ref name="ss" />
